items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: They got Doc Pomler, he's a mighty good trumpet player. He's in Jackson still.

ctx.x: You were going to say something else there?

Yeah, well I was going to speak about some musicians. Still around that way, down around New Orleans, Jackson, Mississippi there. They got Doc Pomler, he's a mighty good trumpet player. He's in Jackson still. Jackson. His brother, he's a good bass, tuba player. Edmund Pomler, his name, we call him Luke. His name's Edmund Pomler. Also, they got one of the world's greatest show drummers around there, Joe White.
So well, yes, I've heard of him. Well, he's in Jackson. He's in Jackson.
